answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to become an Executive Creative Director and CEO of my own creative agency that integrates photography, production, advertising, and branding. A more immediate goal of mine is to become an Art/Creative Director for a creative agency.
answers.drew: What drew me to the entertainment industry was my desire to express myself through storytelling, drawing from my unique perspective on life and personal experiences. In 2020, I picked up a camera, everything changed for me. It provided me with an outlet to fully and creatively express myself during a time when the outside world seemed distant and mute. This newfound passion led me to establish a photography business, and then I secured internship opportunities that helped me realize the kind of impact I could and wanted to make in the broader entertainment space.
answers.seeking: I am actively seeking connections with individuals working in advertising, television/film, photography, directing, producing, and other related fields within the entertainment industry. I believe that networking not just up but across is crucial, as you never know who might know someone who could be a valuable resource. Also, help each grow as the next generation in the come up. By meeting a diverse range of people, I hope to expand my creative community and gain insights into different aspects of the entertainment spaces.
answers.inspiration: My inspirations include photographers like Tim Walker, choreographers like Todd Williams, musicians like Bktherula and Nobu Woods. Among these, BK and Nobu Woods stand out as my biggest inspirations. It encourages people to think for themselves, as long as they have the confidence to keep going and reach their own greatest heights.Nobu Woods’ music, on the other hand, is vulnerable, poetic, moody, and realistic. He focuses on emotional maturity and honesty, both towards others and most importantly, himself. The themes and approaches these artists use to translate their thoughts into melodies are akin to how I view my own work. My concepts revolve around realism and the complexities of life, and I explore how I approach and interpret them.
